title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: The Undercover Man
description: Two Treasury agents (Glenn Ford, James Whitmore) set out to nail a mobster for tax evasion.

title: The Cockleshell Heroes
description: A British major (Jose Ferrer) and captain (Trevor Howard) lead marines in canoes on a mission to mine Nazi ships in Bordeaux.

title: Boots Malone
description: Has-been agent Boots Malone (William Holden) is dodging his creditors and living on the edge of the horse racing world when wealthy teenager Tommy Gibson (Johnny Stewart) asks Malone to take him under his wing as a jockey-in-training.

title: What a Woman!
description: An author (Willard Parker) and a literary agent (Rosalind Russell) become involved after selling film rights to his racy book.

title: The Heroes of Telemark
description: A freedom fighter (Richard Harris) and a scientist (Kirk Douglas) sink a shipment of heavy water en route to Berlin from a Nazi factory in Norway.

title: Jeanne Eagels
description: A 1920s dancer/actress (Kim Novak) leaves her jealous lover (Jeff Chandler) for Broadway, Hollywood and alcoholic decline.

title: Diamond Head
description: The head (Charlton Heston) of a Hawaiian pineapple dynasty refuses to let his sister (Yvette Mimieux) marry a native.

title: The Notorious Landlady
description: A U.S. diplomat (Jack Lemmon) tries to help his London landlady (Kim Novak) in a mix-up over jewels and her husband's murder.

title: To Sir, With Love
description: Unable to find employment in his field, a black engineer accepts a teaching position in a tough East End London school.

title: A Raisin in the Sun
description: Proud members (Sidney Poitier, Claudia McNeil, Ruby Dee) of a Chicago family argue over a $10,000 insurance windfall.

title: Murderers' Row
description: A secret agent blocks a villain's helio-beam plot in the second of four Matt Helm movies.

title: The Mating of Millie
description: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.

title: The Long Gray Line
description: On the eve of his retirement, an Irish immigrant looks back upon his lifetime of service to West Point military academy.

title: Born Free
description: The British Adamsons raise Elsa the lioness as a pet in Kenya, then teach her how to be wild again.

title: Phffft!
description: Being with a blonde (Kim Novak) and a bachelor makes a divorced lawyer (Jack Lemmon) and TV writer (Judy Holliday) want to be back together.

title: A Woman of Distinction
description: Scandalous rumors link the dean (Rosalind Russell) of a women's college with a professor of astronomy (Ray Milland) from England.

title: Run Wild, Run Free
description: A retired British colonel (John Mills) and a white colt draw a mute boy (Mark Lester) out of his shell on a moor.

title: Operation Mad Ball
description: An Army private (Jack Lemmon) and his buddies try to fraternize with nurses who are off-limits as officers.

title: Salome
description: A dancing princess (Rita Hayworth) loves a Roman commander (Stewart Granger) and inspires King Herod (Charles Laughton) to have John the Baptist beheaded.

title: Miss Grant Takes Richmond
description: A bookie's (William Holden) innocent new secretary (Lucille Ball) thinks she's working in a real-estate office.

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).

title: First Men in the Moon
description: An old man (Edward Judd) recalls how he, his fiancée (Martha Hyer) and a professor (Lionel Jeffries) planted a Union Jack on the moon in 1899.

title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
description: A World War II widow (Rosalind Russell) overcomes a mental block thanks to one (Melvyn Douglas) of the five soldiers her husband died for.

title: Born Yesterday
description: A scrap-metal tycoon (Broderick Crawford) pays a Washington newsman (William Holden) to make his girlfriend (Judy Holliday) couth.

title: The Chase
description: An escaped convict (Robert Redford) heads for his wife (Jane Fonda) and corrupt small-town Texans, who order a sheriff (Marlon Brando) to stop him.

title: We Were Strangers
description: A Cuban (Jennifer Jones) lets a rebel (John Garfield) use her home as a base for digging a tunnel to blow up a dictatorship.

title: The Harder They Fall
description: A fight promoter (Rod Steiger) hires a hard-luck sportswriter (Humphrey Bogart) to hype a simple Argentine boxer for the mob.

title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
description: Sinbad the sailor (Kerwin Mathews) needs the egg of a giant two-headed bird of prey to restore a shrunken princess (Kathryn Grant).

title: Boston Blackie and the Law
description: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

title: Gidget Goes to Rome
description: Teenage Gidget (Cindy Carol) and boyfriend Moondoggie (James Darren) cause romantic confusion on vacation in Italy.

title: It Should Happen to You
description: An executive (Peter Lawford) and a filmmaker (Jack Lemmon) woo a model (Judy Holliday) famous for having her name on a billboard.

title: The Caine Mutiny
description: A World War II Naval officer is court-martialed for relieving paranoid Capt. Queeg of command during a typhoon.

title: You Belong to Me
description: A doctor's (Barbara Stanwyck) idle millionaire husband (Henry Fonda) becomes unbearably jealous of her patients.

title: Paula
description: A boy left mute by a hit-and-run accident discovers his speech teacher (Loretta Young) was the driver.

title: The Black Knight
description: A common swordsmith (Alan Ladd) freelances for King Arthur to prove himself worthy of an earl's daughter (Patricia Medina).

title: Tight Spot
description: A detective (Brian Keith) guards a brassy blonde (Ginger Rogers) freed from prison to be a federal prosecutor's (Edward G. Robinson) key mob witness.

title: First Comes Courage
description: A British commando (Brian Aherne) loves a Norwegian spy (Merle Oberon) who is willing to marry a Nazi major (Carl Esmond) for the Allied cause.

title: Pushover
description: A gangster's girlfriend (Kim Novak) seduces a police detective (Fred MacMurray) who has her under surveillance.

title: American Madness
description: An idealistic bank officer is taken to task by the board of directors when they learn of his unorthodox loan policies.

title: The Doctor Takes a Wife
description: A writer (Loretta Young) and a neurologist (Ray Milland) accept rumors of their marriage when each stands to gain from the mistake.
